title: Insufficient Nodes In Root To Leaf Paths
statement:
A root-to-leaf path is sufficient if the sum of its node values is at least `limit`. Remove every node that belongs to no sufficient root-to-leaf path, simultaneously, and return the resulting root or `None` if the tree is removed.

## Examples

```text
Input: root = [1,2,3,4,-99,-99,7,8,9,-99,-99,12,13,-99,14], limit = 1
Output: [1,2,3,4,null,null,7,8,9,null,14]
```

```text
Input: root = [1,2,-3,-5,null,4,null], limit = -1
Output: [1,null,-3,4]
```

## Constraints

- The tree has `[1, 5000]` nodes
- `-10^5 <= Node.val <= 10^5`
- `-10^9 <= limit <= 10^9`
